mapping_scope: Presentation labels identify eleven report milestones independently of the 350 configurations and six experiment rounds. Experiment IDs, predictions and scores are preserved; paths use normalized workspace names.

shared_protocol.cv_mean_definition: Arithmetic mean of the five fold RMSE values; distinct from pooled OOF RMSE.
shared_protocol.cv_std_definition: Sample SD across folds (ddof=1); not a confidence interval or repeated-run SD.
shared_protocol.preprocessing: Learned preprocessing fits only on the corresponding training partition. Test labels are never used.
shared_protocol.target: A predicts dollar prices; B-K predict natural-log prices. All scores use natural-log price error.
shared_protocol.raw_csv_reading: keep_default_na=False; na_values=['NA', '']; preserve literal categorical None.
shared_protocol.neural_fit_scope: H-K load released pretrained neural checkpoints; fit supplies training context and fitted preprocessing.
shared_protocol.selection_limitation: Development folds and online feedback informed model selection.
shared_protocol.kaggle_null_meaning: This milestone was not uploaded; null does not denote a zero score.
